_readme: SEO build configuration (tools/seo). siteOrigin + sitePrefix form the absolute URLs written into sitemaps and
canonical tags; publicRoot is the path under which the generated canonical pages live (independent of where
dge/data physically is, so the storage can move later without a URL change).
excludePrefixes: internal taxonomy prefixes never rendered as public pages (licensed corpora per
dge/GO_LIVE_ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2, until the lead classifies them per entry); includePrefixes wins over
excludePrefixes for a sub-tree the lead has cleared. rootMap renames a top-level internal folder for the public
URL; dropSegments are removed wherever they occur (mula = the default text layer); single-child chains collapse
automatically. canonicalLive: the reader adds <link rel=canonical> to the generated page only once those pages
are actually served (flip to true after the Pages source is switched to GitHub Actions, or after the Firebase deploy).
catalogueUrl: the generated 'All texts' index. It must NOT be <publicRoot>/ — that is the reader app's own
index.html, which the build never overwrites (build_seo_site.Site.write refuses to replace an unstamped file).
